title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

zh.question: 生成模型如何利用外部知识？
zh.method: 结合序列生成模型与稠密检索索引，比较整段生成共享检索内容和逐 token 使用不同内容的方式。
zh.evidence: 作者在开放域问答和生成任务中报告了相对基线的提升。
zh.boundary: 摘要中的结果限于论文任务与基线，不表示任意知识库接入后都能提高准确率。
zh.prompt: 阅读时检查：检索失败如何影响生成？知识来源能否追溯？

en.question: How can generation use external knowledge?
en.method: Combine a sequence generator with dense retrieval; compare shared passages per sequence with passages that can change per token.
en.evidence: The authors report improvements on open-domain QA and generation tasks.
en.boundary: Results concern the paper's tasks and baselines, not every knowledge-base integration.
en.prompt: Reading questions: how do retrieval failures affect output, and can evidence be traced?

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models

zh.question: 语言模型如何结合推理与环境交互？
zh.method: 交替生成推理轨迹和任务动作，通过外部信息更新行动计划。
zh.evidence: 作者在问答、事实核查与交互决策基准上报告实验结果。
zh.boundary: 特定基准表现不等于真实工具调用可靠，也不能将生成的解释视为正确性的证明。
zh.prompt: 阅读时检查：动作失败如何恢复？是否与不使用工具的基线公平比较？

en.question: How can a language model combine reasoning with interaction?
en.method: Interleave reasoning traces and task actions, using external information to update plans.
en.evidence: The authors report evaluations on QA, fact verification and interactive decision-making benchmarks.
en.boundary: Benchmark performance does not establish reliable real-world tool use; explanations are not proof of correctness.
en.prompt: Reading questions: how are failed actions handled, and are no-tool baselines comparable?

title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control

zh.question: 视觉语言知识如何用于机器人控制？
zh.method: 将动作表示为文本 token，并用机器人轨迹和视觉语言任务共同微调。
zh.evidence: 作者报告了机器人评估中新对象与新指令相关的泛化能力。
zh.boundary: 不应据此推断对任意硬件或环境都能泛化；本站尚未复现该模型。
zh.prompt: 阅读时检查：动作表示、数据分布与执行系统分别承担什么作用？

en.question: How can visual-language knowledge support robotic control?
en.method: Represent actions as text tokens and co-fine-tune on robot trajectories and vision-language tasks.
en.evidence: The authors report generalization involving new objects and instructions in robotic evaluations.
en.boundary: This does not imply generalization to arbitrary hardware or environments. No reproduction has been performed here.
en.prompt: Reading questions: what roles do action representation, data distribution and execution play?
